source_identity_checks.hash_provenance: scPerturb SHA-256 from prior audited build; MD5/size rechecked against Zenodo. X-Atlas SHA-256 rechecked against pinned LFS metadata. Full source bytes were not acquired.

reconstruction_scope.rule: Compare included construct rows exactly; compare full target rows only where all source constructs for that target are included. Otherwise compare with exact sum of the included immutable reference construct rows, explicitly labelled partial-target universe. All control identities retained for aggregation, irrespective of responder subsampling.

artifact_contract_proposal.exact_construct_id: JSON array [paired-library namespace, verbatim source construct label], UTF-8; namespace is shared by the two contexts, not a source-file hash. Retain source label separately. No reordering, alias resolution, or P-class reinterpretation.
artifact_contract_proposal.components: All observed labels contain exactly two nonempty | separated component labels. Split/join is lossless; these are labels, not verified protospacer sequences, and never independent observations.
artifact_contract_proposal.cell_locator: source SHA-256 + file/shard path + zero-based original source row index; retain source cell_barcode and source obs index where available. No global uniqueness assumption for barcode.
artifact_contract_proposal.assignments: Selected cells only; summarize exclusions by reason in manifest. Preserve n_cells and raw native-axis total UMI. Preserve core_scale_factor verbatim where present; do not designate it an exposure until semantics are verified.
artifact_contract_proposal.cell_splits: Seed 0; SHA-256 of a versioned canonical JSON tuple (seed, canonical cell locator); sort within context x batch x exact construct, break hash ties by locator, then assign round-robin to 4 labels. Proposed deterministic stratum-specific SHA-256 start rotation avoids placing all singleton strata in split 0. Balancing max-minus-min <=1 holds within each stratum; empty splits remain explicit.
artifact_contract_proposal.batch_folds: Independent domain-separated hash of context + batch; whole batches assigned to folds (propose 4 folds, balanced by hash rank modulo 4). Cell split index is not used. A fold is technical-batch held-out, not an asserted biological replicate.
artifact_contract_proposal.controls: Illustrative SHA-256 role allocation: 25% exact identities D training, 25% null evaluation, 50% effect baseline; same label always same role across contexts. Freeze explicit lists after coverage review. Null identity excluded from its baseline. Shared-cell baseline versus independent-cell baseline calculations use recoverable atomic sums.
artifact_contract_proposal.responder_control_subset: Illustrative cap 128 cells per eligible batch. Allocate across frozen roles and then identities using deterministic hash ranking/round-robin; record per-stratum eligible and selected counts and inclusion weights. The cap cannot retain every identity within every batch. Keep all controls in identity x batch x split pseudobulks regardless.
artifact_contract_proposal.logical_hashes: Hash canonical schemas, native gene order/IDs, sorted row keys, integer n_cells/UMIs and canonical CSR int64 values/int32 indices/int64 indptr in little-endian blocks. Remove explicit zeros and sort indices. Hash upstream floating fields as declared fixed-width bytes; exclude timestamps/compression from logical hashes. SHA-256 each physical file separately for transport.
artifact_contract_proposal.preservation: Raw nonnegative integer counts; full native gene axis; no normalization/filtering/HVG selection beyond explicitly approved source-cell universe. Later duplicate collapse in raw count space only.

unresolved_decisions: 415-target union versus all shared exact constructs, separately for each paired library; H1 remains unchanged.
All selected constructs versus only multiconstruct targets for batch-resolved expression; assignment counts alone cannot recover missing batch expression.

Four-split common-batch support and common fixed weighting; retaining n>=4 strata changes the estimand and discards many cells, while varying support across splits confounds powers with batch composition.
Minimum cells per atomic split and number of eligible training/evaluation batches; >=4 is only a nonempty-split condition, not adequate power.
Control role allocation and handling batches with too few role-specific controls; preserve unsupported batches rather than silently pool across batches.
Responder panel and control retention: all eligible controls versus deterministic cap; 128/batch is illustrative, not selected.
Frozen response-gene axis, alias mapping (if any), and independent-control D design before standardized analysis. Primary raw total-UMI rate analysis remains first.
Approve exact downloads, worker/disks, spending stop, source/scratch retention lifecycle; confirm regional prices and quota headroom before provisioning.

cloud_proposal.execution: one context at a time; one expression shard in memory; disk-backed accumulators/chunked writers; no all-strata dense accumulator
cloud_proposal.pricing_status: Planning allowances, not a binding regional quote. Official pricing pages checked 2026-09-24; their static rendering defaults to Iowa. Confirm London SKU quote before provisioning.
cloud_proposal.retention: Stop VM when job ends or fails safely. Retain source/scratch for review until independently validated durable outputs and agreed lifecycle permit deletion. No persistent source mirror. Archive before any future canonical replacement; this release only stages new outputs.
cloud_proposal.inventory_scope: Only proposed vcc-split names queried. KOLF resources intentionally not inspected; no statement about project-wide inventory or continuing pre-existing costs.

limitations: Metadata establishes exact occupancy, not effect signal or responder viability.
Small metadata reads do not recompute entire source file hashes; expression integrity is revalidated after approved acquisition.

X-Atlas selected-cell nnz is estimated using per-context full-source footer density; use 0.5x–2x for planning. Compression and output metadata overhead are unmeasured. Dense CSR bounds are also supplied.
Source upstream biological filtering remains inherited author processing; the builders do not undo it. Native axes are not complete human transcriptomes.
Exact component-label parsing does not establish sgRNA sequences, promoter biology, or independent guide experiments.
Current X-Atlas checkpoint sums cannot recover within-batch cell splits or responder cells.
No source expression downloaded, no cell split builders executed, no scientific effect estimates generated in Phase A.

validation.four_way_nonempty_condition: n>=4 necessary and sufficient for nonempty round-robin bins; n=3 must yield an empty bin
validation.negative_control: A one-cell perturbation of an expected construct count must fail the equality check; exercised in report QA.
